Adaptive traffic signals

Research · IEEE CICN 2026

YOLOv8 vehicle detection with a two-stage proportional allocation algorithm and weights for bikes, cars, buses and trucks. In my simulated tests it cut weighted waiting time by 31.1% against fixed-time signals.
